paper.title_en: Anatomy of charge radii of Ca nuclei in self-consistent approaches with Skyrme and Fayans functionals
paper.abstract_en: It has been known that the $^{40-48}$Ca nuclei have anomalous $N$-dependence of their charge radii. While difficult to reproduce in most self-consistent calculations, the parabolic behavior in $^{42,44,46}$Ca is reproduced with the Fayans functional, although it tends to overestimate the charge radii at the neutron-deficient $^{38}$Ca. We investigate the origin of the $N$-dependence with the Fayans functional by decomposing it into radial contributions, and trace it back to the single-particle potentials and neutron pair densities. The results are compared with those of a Skyrme functional SkM$^\ast$, which is considered a representative of the usual functionals. It is found that, in the results of the Fayans functional, the origin is shared between the parabolic behavior in $^{42,44,46}$Ca and the erroneous enhancement of the charge radii at $^{38}$Ca. To fully resolve the puzzle with respect to the parabolic charge radii in $^{42,44,46}$Ca, it is vital to reproduce the neutron-deficient region simultaneously.
